name: AnyImg
summary: Edits or creates images with a prompt across listed models, on two official monthly credit plans: Starter 9 € and Pro 27 €.
description: AnyImg is a web image tool for text-to-image and image-to-image across the models listed on its pricing page. Official pricing: two monthly plans. Credits are valid for 1 month. Downloads and a commercial license are included. Higher-resolution and advanced models may use more credits. Failed generation tasks automatically return consumed credits.

pricing.details: Starter 9 €/month (1,600 credits); Pro 27 €/month (5,000 credits). Credits are valid for 1 month. Downloads and a commercial license are included. Failed jobs return credits.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Text-to-image and image-to-image across listed models
